items.title: Equifax (EFX) Just Raised $1 Billion Through Two Back To Back Note Sales
items.summary: Equifax (NYSE:EFX) has completed two substantial fixed income offerings in quick succession. The company issued senior unsecured notes with fixed coupons in back to back transactions. The deals add new fixed rate debt to Equifax’s capital structure and expand its funding sources. Equifax is best known for its consumer credit reporting and related data services, which sit at the center of lending and identity risk decisions.
